description: This file defines the class RecalculateInterestPoster which implements a callable task to recalculate interest for a collection of loans within the Fineract system. It manages thread-local context initialization and error handling during the process.

classes.name: RecalculateInterestPoster
classes.description: A class implementing Callable<Void> to handle batch interest recalculation for loans, with error management and thread-local context handling.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Executes the interest recalculation for each loan ID, managing context and errors, and throws JobExecutionException if errors occur.
